scenes.vo: Last night I remembered. On my first night, I whispered Who's there. It has had my voice ever since.
Mrs. Dorsey took out her knitting. There is one way back, she said. At three AM, YOU knock. Three times.
If the thing inside answers, you trade places. You go in, it goes out. But you only get ONE try.
So I climbed. Six. Seven. Eight. The stairs went on to NINE, like they knew. My phone said two fifty nine.
At three, I raised my fist. Knock. Knock. Knock. Nothing. Then something soft walked up to the other side.
From inside, in my own voice, it whispered: Who's THERE?
